problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on a real Hilbert space E. For every x,y, f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩ ≤ f(y) ≤ f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+(L/2)‖y−x‖². A global minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x₀−x⋆‖≤R; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle accepts x∈E and returns g∈E satisfying ‖g−∇f(x)‖≤α‖∇f(x)‖ for every history, query, and seed. Function values are not supplied. Answers may depend on the full history, and oracle seeds may be dependent.

distinctive_assumptions.label: biased_oracle
distinctive_assumptions.details: No unbiasedness or mean-zero condition is imposed; arbitrary bias is permitted within the pointwise relative-error bound.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The error bound is pointwise relative to the true gradient norm. With Q=2+LR²/ε, validity requires 0≤α<1 and α≤exp(−8(1+√log Q))/100.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space, with no finite-dimensional restriction. E, L, x₀, α, R, and ε are public; L>0, R≥0, and ε>0. The objective and its minimizer are hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x∈E satisfying f(x)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. There is no requirement that the output be a queried point.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the product of the algorithm-seed law and oracle-seed law, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines smooth convex Hilbert-space optimization with arbitrary pointwise relative gradient errors and an accuracy-dependent exponential restriction on their magnitude. Repository implementations and proofs were not inspected; no qualifying reference is a search outcome, not a novelty claim.
